text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I've noticed a change in <chrname> ever since our first concert.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Almost as if the heated passion of that stage has yet to cool in her…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I bring this up with Light Hello during a meeting.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text: Ah, s-sorry, didn't mean to shout. It's just, I can relate—I feel like I've been way more productive since our first concert.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text: …Maybe this is the power of concerts.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It would seem that concerts have a positive effect on morale and growth, whether you experience them on stage or off.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Now then, time to think about our next concert's setlist. Somehow, work for <chrname>'s sake doesn't feel like work.
